root_cause: The pod cannot pull the specified image because the image "nginx:does-not-exist" does not exist in the registry.
The pod cannot pull the image because the registry host "registry.invalid" cannot be resolved, causing a DNS lookup failure.
The pod’s container image reference "nginx::bad" is not a valid Docker image name, causing the image pull to fail.
The container exits immediately because the required environment variable DB_URL is not set.
The application container exits immediately because it cannot connect to the PostgreSQL service at db:5432, causing a CrashLoopBackOff.
The pod’s container exceeded its memory limit (50Mi) while trying to allocate 200Mi of memory with the stress command, causing an OOMKilled event.
The container fails to start because the specified command "/bin/doesnotexist" does not exist in the image, causing an exec error.
The pod cannot be scheduled because the requested CPU (1k) exceeds the available CPU on the only node.
The pod cannot start because the ConfigMap "app-config" referenced in its spec does not exist.
The pod cannot start because the secret "db-credentials" referenced in the container’s environment variable is missing.
